company.name: WebTeb
company.shortDescription: Medical and Health Portal In Arabic
company.description:
WebTeb's goal is to provide Arabic-language comprehensive health and medical information so that its Arabic-speaking users can live better and healthier lives. 
WebTeb publishes exclusive and high-quality evidence-based medical information and continuously update it. The company is managed by a professional team that includes doctors, editors and programmers.
WebTeb strives to be the leading professional and reliable source of information for Arabic-speaking users and to provide a platform for their interaction with health practitioners, hospitals, doctors, dentists, pharmacies, pharmaceutical companies, insurance companies, therapists, and health education institutions.

productsAndServices.description: An Arabic-language online platform providing medical and health information articles, covering various health topics and conditions.
productsAndServices.name: WebTeb Medical and Health Portal

productsAndServices.description: An online service allowing users to book appointments with medical specialists, such as gynecologists, through WebTeb's electronic clinic.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $3,200,000, or 62.75% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,240,563 to $17,099,687, a 1.85x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 38 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 11 (+1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Altibbi, NHS, Vezeeta.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
